mapper.sql: (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = h.hobby_id AND r.file_type = 'HOBBY' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1)
mapper.select: SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, h.name AS hobby_name, h.summary, h.difficulty_cd, h.equipment, h.estimated_cost, h.board_id, h.sort_no, dc.name AS difficulty_name, bi.name AS board_name, AS thumb_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post b WHERE b.board_id = h.board_id AND b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_post_id = 0) AS post_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_hobby uh WHERE uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y') AS member_cnt FROM hobby h LEFT JOIN code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' LEFT JOIN board bi ON bi.board_id = h.board_id WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND h.name LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%' ORDER BY h.sort_no, h.hobby_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND board_id = #{boardId}::integer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hobby h WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND h.name LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, h.name AS hobby_name, h.summary, h.intro, h.guide, h.difficulty_cd, h.equipment, h.estimated_cost, h.board_id, h.sort_no, dc.name AS difficulty_name, bi.name AS board_name, AS thumb_id FROM hobby h LEFT JOIN code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' LEFT JOIN board bi ON bi.board_id = h.board_id WHERE h.hobby_id = #{rowId}::integer AND h.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hobby (name, summary, intro, guide, difficulty_cd, equipment, estimated_cost, board_id, sort_no, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{hobbyName}, NULLIF(#{summary}, ''), #{intro}, #{guide}, NULLIF(#{difficultyCd}, ''), NULLIF(#{equipment}, ''), NULLIF(#{estimatedCost}, ''), NULLIF(#{boardId}, '')::integer, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) + 1 FROM hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y')), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE hobby SET name = #{hobbyName}, summary = NULLIF(#{summary}, ''), intro = #{intro}, guide = #{guide}, difficulty_cd = NULLIF(#{difficultyCd}, ''), equipment = NULLIF(#{equipment}, ''), estimated_cost = NULLIF(#{estimatedCost}, ''), board_id = NULLIF(#{boardId}, '')::integer, sort_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE hobby_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE hobby SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE hobby_id = #{rowId}::integer
